subject: general
question: The average of 26 numbers is 54.5. The average of the first 15 numbers is 58.6 and that of the last 12 numbers is 52. If the 15th number is excluded, the average of the remaining numbers will be:
solution:
Given:

The average of 26 numbers = 54.5

The average of the first 15 numbers = 58.6

The average of the last 12 numbers = 52

Concept used:

Total = Average × Number of entities

Calculation:

According to the question,

1st + 2nd + 3rd + .... + 15th = 58.6 × 15

⇒ 1st + 2nd + 3rd + .... + 15th = 879 ....(1)

26th + 25th + 24th + .... + 15th = 52 × 12

⇒ 26th + 25th + 24th + .... + 15th = 624 ....(2)

1st + 2nd + 3rd + .... + 15th + .... + 24th + 25th + 26th = 54.5 × 26

⇒ 1st + 2nd + 3rd + .... + 15th + .... + 24th + 25th + 26th = 1417 ....(3)

Adding equation(1) and equation(2),

1st + 2nd + 3rd + ... + 15th + 15th + .... + 24th + 25th + 26th = 1503

⇒ 1st + 2nd + 3rd + ... + 15th + 15th + .... + 24th + 25th + 26th = 1503

⇒ (1st + 2nd + 3rd + ... + 15th + .... + 24th + 25th + 26th) + 15th = 1503

⇒ 1417 + 15th = 1503 (From 3)

⇒ 15th = 1503 - 1417

⇒ 15th = 86

Now, the average of the remaining term = (1417 - 86)/(26 - 1)

⇒ 1331/25 = 53.24

**Hence, the average of numbers excluding 15th number is 53.24**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**

The average of 26 numbers is 54.5

 The average of the first 15 numbers is 58.6, 

Which is (58.6 - 54.5) = 4.1 more than the total average,

So, the 1st, 15 numbers contributes (4.1 × 15) = 61.5 more

Similarly,

For the next 12 numbers (54.5 - 52) = 2.5 less than total average,

So, these 12 numbers contribute (2.5 × 12) = 30 less

Now, the 15th number will be 54.5 + (61.5 - 30) = 86,

The 15th number take out (86 - 54.5) = 31.5 more than the total

average, the loss of 31.5 will be distributed among the remaining

25 numbers,

So, the average of the remaining numbers is 

⇒ 54.5- ( 31.5/25 ) 

⇒ 54.5 - 1.26 = 53.24

Hence, the average of numbers excluding 15th number is 53.24
